name: std-learn-trace-player
description: Generic auto-playing frame-sequence instrument — the timed-autoplay sibling of std-learn-stepper: a config-declared ordered roster of frames (each frame a label, caption, and a numeric value snapshot with optional highlighted indices) advances on a fixed tick while Play is engaged, Pause freezes the cursor in place, and Restart rewinds to the first frame; reaching the last frame either loops back to the start (config loop) or stops and emits a completion signal. The current frame's values render as bars on an algorithm-canvas with highlighted indices picked out by color, alongside a frame k of n readout and a caption card narrating what changed, so the same mechanism serves any ordered numeric-trace domain (sorting steps, iterative approximations, simulation snapshots, and beyond). Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

The current frame's values render as bars on an algorithm-canvas with highlighted indices picked out by color, alongside a frame k of n readout and a caption card narrating what changed, so the same mechanism serves any ordered numeric-trace domain (sorting steps, iterative approximations, simulation snapshots, and beyond). emits.description: The current frame cursor after Play/Pause/Restart or a tick step — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: frame update, tick, step, trace advance

emits.description: The trace reached its last frame and loop is off, so autoplay stopped on its own — fires once per completed pass.
emits.synonyms: playback complete, sequence finished, trace end

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Play
events.description: Learner pressed Play — the frame cursor begins advancing on the tick until the last frame is reached or Pause is pressed.

events.name: Pause
events.description: Learner pressed Pause — the frame cursor freezes at its current position.

events.name: Restart
events.description: Learner pressed Restart — the frame cursor rewinds to the first frame and playback stops.

events.name: Frame Advanced
events.description: The current frame cursor after Play/Pause/Restart or a tick step — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: frame update, tick, step, trace advance

events.name: Trace Done
events.description: The trace reached its last frame and loop is off, so autoplay stopped on its own — fires once per completed pass.
events.synonyms: playback complete, sequence finished, trace end

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: When true, autoplay wraps from the last frame back to the first instead of stopping and emitting TRACE_DONE.

matchMode.label: Match Mode
matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

tickMs.label: Tick Milliseconds
tickMs.description: Milliseconds per frame shown in the readout; the autoplay cadence.

baseColor.label: Base Bar Color
baseColor.description: Color of bars not highlighted in the current frame.

frames.label: Frames
frames.description: Ordered roster of frames (label, caption, values, highlights) stepped through by Play/Pause/Restart. Each frame's values render as bars; highlighted indices pick out which bars changed.
frames.synonyms: trace, animation frames, snapshot roster, playback sequence, keyframes

highlightColor.label: Highlight Bar Color
highlightColor.description: Color of bars whose index appears in the current frame's highlights.
